post.description:
Marks an open instance done: `submitted` for a parent to approve, or `approved` with points credited when the chore doesn't require approval. Kids complete their own instances (or shared ones they're a member of); a parent completes for a kid and names the kid for a shared instance. An instance dated after today can't be completed yet (409 `instance_planned`), nor one whose day (or week) has closed (409 `instance_closed`): day close counts it as missed.

The evidence comes with it and is checked against the chore's rules (422 `validation_failed`, with the field's location): every step ticked when it has a checklist, a note when it asks for one, at least its number of photos, with a `before` and an `after` when it asks for both. Each photo is a pending upload by the kid, or by the parent completing for them, not used before. A kid's photo carries its `capturedAt` and `captureId` and must be taken after the instance's day (or a flexible chore's week) began. A chore that asks for a video can't be completed yet (422 `video_evidence_unsupported`). Every submission is kept, so resubmitting after a rejection adds one. Returns the updated instance.

post.description: A multipart form with the image in `file` (JPEG, PNG or WebP, recognized by its content, not its declared type; HEIC isn't supported). The server applies the EXIF orientation, scales the photo to at most 1600 px on its long edge, makes a 320 px thumbnail, and re-encodes both as WebP without any metadata (EXIF, GPS). The photo is pending until a completion attaches it as evidence; one not attached within 24 hours is deleted. A kid's photo that exactly matches earlier kid evidence is rejected with 409 `duplicate_media`, except that a kid repeating their own upload that is still pending (an offline retry) gets that photo back. A kid may hold 20 pending photos; more is 429 `rate_limited`. Images over 24 MP or 12,000 px on a side, or that would need too much memory to decode, get 413; animated images get 415. Photos are processed one at a time; when several uploads are already waiting the answer is 503 `media_busy`, and a caller with two uploads in progress gets 429 `rate_limited`, both with Retry-After.
